value.rationale: Missing matchings are a canonical sparse perturbation of complete bipartite graphs, including all crown graphs. The result gives a natural complete orbit-and-basin classification for the entire two-part-size and matching-size family, with quadratic growth of distinct oscillatory cycles from only linearly many removed edges yet uniform concentration on a single oscillation. Individual basins, transition boundaries, and an exact random-initial-condition probability are mathematically substantive beyond correctness or mere enumeration.
